chunks: Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār narrated from him, peace be upon him, that he said:
"There is no harm in killing ants and bedbugs in the Haram."
And he said: "There is no harm in killing a louse in the Haram and elsewhere."

key_terms.غَيْرِهِ: other than it; outside the Haram
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or legal objection

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to kill ants, bedbugs, or lice in the Haram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning small harmful creatures in the Haram. It states that killing ants, bedbugs, and lice is permitted, clarifying an exception within the sanctity of the sacred precinct.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2384 - Muawiya ibn Ammar narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) that he said:
"There is no harm in killing ants and bedbugs in the sacred sanctuary (Al-Haram)."
Imam (as) also said: "There is no harm in killing lice both within the sanctuary and outside of it."
